addParticipant(uint256,address).details: Only the trip admin may call this function.         Allowed only when settlementStatus == None and the trip is not locked.         Known limitation: smart-contract wallets (Safe, ERC-4337 accounts, etc.)         are rejected because extcodesize > 0 for deployed contracts. This is a         deliberate trade-off: claimRefund performs a USDC safeTransfer to each         settlement member, and a contract wallet that cannot accept ERC-20 transfers         would permanently block the settlement for all other participants. If you need         a smart-contract wallet to participate, use a wrapper EOA or ensure the wallet         can receive ERC-20 tokens before adding it — but note that addParticipant will         still revert for any address whose extcodesize is non-zero at call time.

params.newParticipant: EOA address to add. Must not be zero, already a participant,                        exceed MAX_PARTICIPANTS, or be a contract address.

cancelSettlement(uint256).details: Only allowed when status is Proposed (before anyone has paid deficit).         If status has advanced to DeficitPaying or beyond, revert —         at that point participants have already committed funds; a new         proposeFinalSettlement can only be submitted once all outstanding         deficits have been handled separately (out-of-contract).

addParticipant(uint256,address).notice: Add a new participant to an existing trip after it has been created.

cancelSettlement(uint256).notice: Admin can cancel a Proposed settlement, resetting status to None.
